title: 0RWX Framework
excerpt: A simple model of AI usage, inspired by unix permissions.
content_html:
INTRODUCTION

We need new language to talk about large language models. 0rwx is my attempt.

A labelling system is vital for domain experts to talk about AI in a clear way. The difference between the 4 levels is not necessarily about what TOOL you use, but your ability to scrutinise the generated work.

I have employed this simple framework to discuss my and others' work with less judgement and confusion, and I hope the 0rwx framework makes it just a little easier for you too. They are:


    ZER0

    AI can't read or write to your work HAND MADE

    I read the docs

    painting w/paint

    playing music

    "I think"

    READ

    AI has read-only permissions AI INSPIRED

    reference images

    chord inspiration

    "I make"

    WRITE

    AI has read-write permissions AI COLLABORATION

    generated collages

    loop generation

    "I fix"

    EXECUTE

    YOU can no longer read your work AI MADE

    I vibe code

    image generation

    song generation

    "I curate"

You are welcome to use these logos, which I release into the public domain. Find more options at the repo!
